subject: great dragon of the wyvern build, as Skyrim's: two strong hind legs, the wings its forelimbs with a clawed thumb at the wrist and four fingers spanning a dark red-brown membrane, long neck, long tail, horned head; scaled hide in dark umber and bronze-green, a paler ribbed belly, bone-ivory horns and claws

origin: the body's centre of mass, between the wing roots and the hips; front +Z, +Y up
